# Products for children

Applies when the change touches: users under 13, or under 16 in the EU. Every role loads this pack for the steps it works in, on top of its own playbook. The test commands below are best practices the gate runs: put them in the Spec's `[[tests.commands]]`, so a red one blocks the merge. Name the pack in the Spec's Context; it does not count against a Task's `skills`.

## Standards

| Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| COPPA | 16 CFR Part 312, 2025 amendments | 2026-09-28 | <https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/rules/childrens-online-privacy-protection-rule-coppa> |
| UK Age Appropriate Design Code | 2021 | 2026-09-28 | <https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/uk-gdpr-guidance-and-resources/childrens-information/childrens-code-guidance-and-resources/> |
| GDPR Article 8 | Regulation (EU) 2016/679 | 2026-09-28 | <https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item |
| --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd next`) | Users under 13, or under 16 in the EU: the privacy and compliance dimensions, major, the privacy pool. |
| Specify | Age assurance, verifiable parental consent, data minimization, and defaults (private by default, no profiling, no nudges) in the Acceptance. |
| Implement | No behavioral advertising, no geolocation by default, no dark pattern; plain-language notices. |
| Review | Every flow of a child's data has a lawful basis and a retention limit. |
| Ship | Consent flows and data-subject requests are the observe signals; a broken consent flow rolls back. |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Consent-flow tests | nothing is collected before consent | end-to-end tests |
| Default-settings tests | private by default, no profiling, no geolocation | unit and end-to-end tests |
| Inventory schema check | every flow of a child's data carries a lawful basis and a retention limit | a schema check over the data-flow inventory |
| SDK audit | no ad or tracking SDK on the child surface | a dependency allow-list check |
| Readability check | notices read at the target age level | a reading-level test in CI |

## Keep it current

A standard marked emerging is a draft, a first edition, or a young practice: apply it only when the change clearly needs it, and say so in the Spec. A standard checked more than a year ago is stale: `aidd eval standards` lists it, and the loop contract's research-first rule applies. When the change needs a standard this pack lacks, look up the authoritative source, record the edition in the Spec's Context, and propose the update to the aidd project's roles registry (`schemas/roles.json` in the aidd repository) as an improvement.
